original_idea.body:
# Replicating Trusted Access Equity Analysis Across Different Attack Domains: Is Equity Worse for ICS/OT Security?

**Problem:** The access equity analysis (Global South defenders) may differ significantly between IT cybersecurity and operational technology (OT/ICS) security, where institutional backing is even scarcer.

**Direction:** Map OpenAI Trusted Access verification requirements against the organizational profile of OT/ICS defenders (small utilities, water treatment plants, regional infrastructure operators) vs. IT security organizations. Score access difficulty differentials. Assess whether critical infrastructure in developing countries can realistically access AI defensive tools.

**Why it matters:** AI cyber governance focused on IT security may create an even larger gap for critical infrastructure defense, particularly in lower-income countries where OT security teams are smallest.

**Relevant context:** OpenAI Trusted Access; Global South equity; NIST AI 800-1; critical infrastructure cybersecurity priorities.
